name: org.odk.collect.android.activities.FirstLaunchActivity
description: When ODK Collect has no project configured, this first-run screen lets the user set one up with a QR code, configure it manually, or continue with the demo project. It is part of the Samagra ODK Collect client.
disableEffect: A new or unconfigured ODK Collect installation will have no setup screen for creating or selecting a project.
